name: Smart Sense
author: Shazahanul Islam Shohag

sections.description:
Enhance your WordPress search experience with AI-powered content summaries.

Smart sense is a smart WordPress solution that automatically generates concise, AI-driven summaries (or “gists”) of your posts, pages, or custom content directly on the search results page. This helps users quickly understand what each result is about — improving user engagement, reducing the bounce rate, and enhancing content discoverability.

Powered by cutting-edge AI models like OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude, this plugin reads and processes your site content to produce clear and relevant summaries for each search result. It works out of the box with most WordPress themes and can be easily customized to match your brand voice or preferred summary style.

Whether you’re running a blog, news portal, online shop, or documentation site — Smart sense delivers a faster and smarter search experience that helps visitors find what they need, faster.

Key Features:
– AI-generated summaries on the WordPress search results page

  • Supports OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude

  • Works with posts, pages, and custom post types

  • Reduces bounce rate and improves SEO by enhancing UX

  • Easy setup, no coding required.

Privacy

This plugin relies on third-party AI services and embedding services to generate content summaries and improve the search experience.

AI Services

When enabled, the plugin will send portions of your site content (such as post titles, excerpts, or full content) to the selected AI provider in order to generate summaries. The specific provider depends on your configuration:

  • OpenAI (ChatGPT)

    • Data sent: post/page/custom post type content (as text) for summary generation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

  • Google Gemini (Google AI Studio)

    • Data sent: post/page/custom post type content (as text) for summary generation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms

  • Anthropic Claude

    • Data sent: post/page/custom post type content (as text) for summary generation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/terms

No personal user data is transmitted unless it is part of the site content itself.

Embedding Service

If embedding is enabled, the plugin may send content data to the configured embedding provider in order to create vector representations (embeddings) of your site content. This allows for improved search and relevance matching. The type of data sent is limited to text content only.

The embedding process is performed by the same provider you configure in the settings (OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude), and is subject to their respective terms and policies (see links above).

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses the following third-party services:
– INSPECTOR (https://inspector.dev/) for observing and analyzing the performance of the AI services.

To use the service set putenv("INSPECTOR_INGESTION_KEY=your_key_here"); in the wp-config.php file.

General Notes

  • The plugin does not collect or store your content outside of your chosen AI provider.
  • All processing of summaries or embeddings occurs via secure API requests to the external provider you configure.
  • By using this plugin and configuring an AI service, you agree that portions of your content will be transmitted to that provider in order to enable the plugin’s functionality.

Configuration

After installation, you’ll need to:
– Obtain API keys from your chosen AI provider
– Configure the AI model settings
– Enable the smart search feature
– Test the functionality on your site’s search page
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins directory or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Smart Sense > Settings in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Configure your AI provider settings:
    • Select your preferred AI provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude)
    • Enter your API key for the selected provider
    • Specify the AI model you want to use
  5. Configure embedding settings if needed.
  6. Enable the services from the Services tab.
  7. Your WordPress search results will now display AI-generated summaries.
sections.faq:
Do I need to provide AI Api keys

Yes, you need to provide API keys for the AI services you want to use. The plugin supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude.
